summary: Umbrella legislation for environmental protection. Powers to government for environmental standards, EIA, and pollution control.
detailed_provisions: Central Government can set environmental quality standards.
EIA notification mandatory for development projects above thresholds.
Environmental standards for air, water, noise, and waste.
Hazardous waste handling and management regulations.
Environmental compensation for damage to environment.
Citizen suit provision for environmental violations.
Public trust doctrine: Government trustee of natural resources.

law_name: Water (Prevention and Control of Pollution) Act, 1974
summary: Water pollution prevention. Effluent standards. Consent framework for industries and construction.
detailed_provisions: Consent to Establish (CTE) required before any discharge into water body.
Consent to Operate (CTO) required for ongoing discharge.
National Water Quality Standards (Schedule I): 38 parameters including BOD, COD, TSS.
Industrial effluent standards: BOD < 30 mg/l, COD < 250 mg/l for inland water.
Sewage: Treated to Class B standards before discharge (BOD < 30 mg/l).
Zero Liquid Discharge: Required for certain industries in water-stressed areas.
River/nlake protection: No untreated discharge into rivers or lakes.
Monitoring: Self-monitoring by consented units. Quarterly reports to SPCB.

law_name: Hazardous and Other Wastes (Management and Transboundary Movement) Rules, 2016
summary: Management of hazardous waste generated from construction, demolition, and industrial activities.
detailed_provisions: Asbestos removal: Licensed contractor required. Proper disposal at hazardous waste facility.
Lead paint removal: Certified removal required before demolition of pre-2005 buildings.
PCB-containing equipment: Special disposal under Basel Convention.
Chemical storage: Proper containment, labeling, and MSDS (Material Safety Data Sheet).
Transportation: Only authorized vehicles with manifest system.
Disposal: Only at authorized Treatment, Storage, and Disposal Facilities (TSDF).
Inventory: Annual hazardous waste inventory filing with SPCB.
Transboundary movement: Prior Informed Consent (PIC) under Basel Convention.

summary: Restriction on diversion of forest land for non-forest purposes. Compensatory afforestation.
detailed_provisions: Prior approval of Central Government required for any non-forest activity on forest land.
Compensatory afforestation: 2:1 ratio (2 hectares for every 1 hectare diverted).
Forest clearance: Stage I and Stage II clearance required.
Canopy density: Trees with > 10cm DBH (Diameter at Breast Height) constitute forest.
Van Mahotsav planting: Compensatory planting on degraded forest land.
Net Present Value (NPV): Payment required for forest diversion.
Community forest rights: FRA (Forest Rights Act) clearance required.
No construction permitted in Reserved Forest and Protected Forest areas.

authority: National Biodiversity Authority (NBA) / State Biodiversity Boards
summary: Protection of biological diversity. Prior approval for projects affecting biodiversity-rich areas.
detailed_provisions: Construction in biodiversity-rich areas requires NBA approval.
Biodiversity Impact Assessment (BIA) for projects > 10 hectares.
No construction within 100m of identified biodiversity heritage sites.
Impact on local species: Mitigation plan required.
Urban biodiversity: Tree replacement mandatory (3:1 for trees cut during construction).
Native species planting: Recommended in urban development projects.

summary: Regulations for construction near national highways. Right of way. Restriction on access and construction.
detailed_provisions: No construction within 50m of national highway boundary (Right of Way).
Access to national highway: Only at designated points. NOC from NHAI required.
Service road: Mandatory along national highways in urban areas.
Road-side development: Green belt of 30m along national highways.
Permission required for any structure affecting highway drainage.
Height restriction: Minimum 5.5m clearance under highway bridges/flyovers.
Noise barrier: Required along national highways passing through residential areas.
Toll plaza: Service road continuity must be maintained.

law_name: IRC (Indian Roads Congress) Standards & State Road Design Standards
summary: Road design and construction standards for urban areas. Width, gradient, junction design.
detailed_provisions: Arterial road: 30-60m. Sub-arterial: 18-30m. Collector: 12-18m. Local: 9-12m.
Carriageway: Minimum 3.5m per lane. Two-way: Minimum 7m.
Footpath: 1.5m minimum (2m preferred). Bicycle track: 2.5m minimum.
Road gradient: Maximum 5% for urban roads, 3% preferred.
Intersection: Traffic signal or roundabout for roads > 12m.
Speed breaker: As per IRC 99 guidelines. Height 75mm, width 300-600mm.
Road marking: As per IRC 67. Mandatory for roads > 7m width.
Street lighting: 1 Lux minimum on residential roads, 15 Lux on arterial.

law_name: Ground Water (Development and Management) Act, 2022 (Model Bill)
summary: Regulation of groundwater extraction. Registration of borewells. Aquifer protection.
detailed_provisions: Registration mandatory for all groundwater extraction structures.
Permit required for > 10 hectare-meter annual extraction.
Rainwater harvesting mandatory as precondition for new extraction.
Aquifer mapping: Critical/Semi-critical/Safe/Over-exploited zones identified.
Over-exploited zones: No new extraction permitted.
Critical zones: Only rainwater recharge structures allowed.
Monitoring: Piezometer installation required for large extractors.
Community participation in groundwater management.

law_name: Flood Management Act (Model) & Dam Safety Act, 2021
summary: Flood protection and management. Construction restrictions in flood-prone areas. Dam safety.
detailed_provisions: Flood-prone area mapping by CWC. Construction restricted in 1-in-100-year flood zone.
Flood buffer: 30m minimum from river bank (varies by river width).
Raised plinth level: Mandatory in flood-prone areas. Minimum 1m above highest flood level.
Dam safety: No construction within 5km downstream of major dams (safety zone).
Encroachment of floodplain: Strictly prohibited.
Storm water drainage: Designed for 50mm/hour rainfall intensity (varies by city).
Flood-resistant construction: Elevated foundation, water-resistant materials.
Early warning system: Required for major construction in flood zones.

summary: Ambient air quality standards applicable across India. Monitoring and compliance requirements.
detailed_provisions: PM2.5: 40 μg/m³ (annual), 60 μg/m³ (24-hr) in residential areas.
PM10: 60 μg/m³ (annual), 100 μg/m³ (24-hr).
SO2: 50 μg/m³ (annual), 80 μg/m³ (24-hr).
NOx: 40 μg/m³ (annual), 80 μg/m³ (24-hr).
CO: 2 mg/m³ (annual), 4 mg/m³ (8-hr).
O3: 100 μg/m³ (8-hr average).
Pb: 0.5 μg/m³ (annual).
Monitoring stations: Required for projects > 50 acres in EIA category.

summary: Indoor air quality standards for buildings. Ventilation requirements. VOC limits.
detailed_provisions: Ventilation: Minimum 2.5 air changes per hour for occupied spaces.
Fresh air: Minimum 5.5 l/s per person in office spaces.
CO2: < 1000 ppm in occupied spaces.
Formaldehyde: < 0.1 mg/m³ in indoor air.
TVOC: < 0.5 mg/m³ in residential spaces.
Low-VOC paints mandatory in public buildings (GRIHA/IGBC credit).
HVAC design: Must meet ASHRAE 62.1 or NBC Part 9 ventilation standards.
Natural ventilation: Cross-ventilation mandatory for residential buildings in India.

summary: Factory construction and safety standards. Building plan approval from Factory Inspector required for certain categories.
detailed_provisions: Factory building plan approval: Mandatory from Factory Inspector for > 20 workers.
Ventilation: Adequate natural or mechanical ventilation. Cross-ventilation for all workplaces.
Lighting: 300 lux minimum for general work, 500 lux for fine work.
Temperature: Thermal comfort standards. Air conditioning for certain factory types.
Emergency exits: Minimum 2 exits per floor. Maximum travel distance 22.5m.
Fire safety: As per NBC Part 5. Fire extinguishers, alarms, and exits mandatory.
Sanitary facilities: 1 toilet per 25 workers (male), 1 per 15 workers (female).
Drinking water: 1 liter per worker per day minimum. Cool drinking water in summer.
First aid: 1 first aid box per 150 workers.

law_name: Petroleum Act, 1934 / Explosive Act, 1884 / State Fire Services Act
summary: Fire safety requirements for industrial buildings. Storage of flammable materials. Fire NOC.
detailed_provisions: Fire NOC mandatory for all industrial buildings > 500 sq.m.
Fire extinguisher: Minimum 1 per 200 sq.m. Types: ABC powder, CO2, foam.
Sprinkler system: Mandatory for buildings > 2000 sq.m. (warehouse/factory).
Fire tender access: 6m wide fire tender passage. Turning radius 12m.
Assembly point: Designated fire assembly area outside building.
Fire alarm system: Manual call points on every floor. Hooter in common areas.
Hazardous material storage: Separate store room with ventilation and fire protection.
Fire water tank: Minimum 45,000 liters for buildings > 15m height.
Annual fire audit: Mandatory by certified fire safety agency.

summary: Land use zoning regulations. Residential, commercial, industrial, mixed-use, and green zone classifications.
detailed_provisions: Residential Zone: Housing, community facilities. No manufacturing.
Commercial Zone: Offices, retail, markets, hotels. No heavy industry.
Industrial Zone: Manufacturing, warehouses. No residential.
Mixed Use Zone: Combination of residential and commercial. Height and FAR restrictions.
Green/Recreational Zone: Parks, playgrounds, open spaces. No construction.
Public/Institutional Zone: Government buildings, hospitals, schools.
Agricultural Zone: Farming. No non-agricultural construction.
Change of Land Use (CLU): Required for converting one zone to another. Government approval.
Buffer Zone: Between incompatible zones (industrial-residential, etc.).

law_name: Ancient Monuments and Archaeological Sites Act, 1958
summary: Protection of heritage sites and monuments. Construction restrictions in heritage zones.
detailed_provisions: Prohibited area: 100m from protected monument. No construction.
Regulated area: 100m-200m from monument. Height restriction: Max 2 floors.
Heritage Impact Assessment mandatory for projects near protected monuments.
Material restriction: Modern materials visible from monument prohibited.
ASI approval mandatory for any construction within regulated area.
Heritage precinct: Design guidelines for facade, material, height.
Underground construction: Requires archaeological survey.
Satellite imagery monitoring: Annual survey of heritage buffer zones.

summary: Height restrictions near airports. Approach zone regulations. Obstacle limitation surfaces.
detailed_provisions: Approach zone: Height restricted as per runway length and approach type.
Clearway: No obstruction within 60m of runway ends.
Inner approach zone: Height = Distance from runway × approach slope.
Visual approach: 1:20 slope. Non-visual: 1:50 slope.
Transitional zone: Height restriction along sides of runway.
Outer horizontal zone: 4000m radius. Max height 45m above airport elevation.
NOTAM notification: For construction > 45m in airport influence zone.
Lighting: Obstruction lights for structures > 30m near airports.
AAI NOC mandatory for all construction within airport influence zone.
